author: Babel
text: Deputy heads of the SBU of Kyiv region and Rivne region were detained — they are suspected of extorting a bribe from a businessman.  Investigators claim that in the Rivne region they demanded $620,000 from the head of a monopolist company in the amber business. For this amount, they promised to close the criminal proceedings that had previously been opened against his company.  Detainees are going to be informed about suspicion of bribery. They face up to ten years behind bars with confiscation.  @babel

author: Babel
text: Adviser to the Minister of Defense Serhii ("Flash") Beskrestnov told the details of the Russian attack on Kyiv yesterday morning.  The goal of the Russians was to demonstrate in Kyiv the wreckage of the Lancet electric drone, which actually does not have enough range to reach the capital — it is used at the front.  The occupiers waited for a favorable wind in the direction of the capital, removed the warhead from 40 "Lancets" and attached additional batteries. Together with them, they launched "Shakheds", on which spare parts of "Lancets" were attached.  At such a long distance, "Lancets" can be controlled at high altitude, but attack on the ground - not. Most of the drones were shot down by the Air Defense Forces of Ukraine on the way to the capital, but a few flew over and left a wreckage on the Independence Square.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🗞 The death of Filaret, the wreckage of the "Lancet" on the Maidan and the trial of the noblewoman Marchenko. The main thing in a week.  🔴On Monday morning, the Russians attacked Kyiv. Then, on the Independence Square, the wreckage of Russian electric drones "Lancet", which cannot reach the capital, was discovered.  Adviser to the Minister of Defense Serhiy "Flash" Beskrestnov said that the occupiers waited for a favorable wind in the direction of the capital, removed the warhead from the drones and attached additional batteries. The goal was to demonstrate the wreckage of this drone in Kyiv.  Babel's new interview with Flash can be viewed on YouTube and read on the website.  🔴On the same day, the SBU detained the deputy heads of the Rivne and Kyiv departments and their intermediary on suspicion of pressure on business and corruption. They face up to 12 years in prison with confiscation.  🔴On Tuesday, Ukraine received the criteria (benchmarks) for joining the European Union according to the three latest negotiating clusters. There are six of them in total, but negotiations on none of the clusters have yet been officially opened.  🔴On Thursday, VAKS sentenced the member of parliament from "Servant of the People" Ludmila Marchenko and her assistant to two years in prison. In 2023, they received $5,300 for a promise to help the man leave Ukraine. Convicted persons can file an appeal.  🔴 On Friday, the honorary patriarch of the OCU and the patriarch of the UOC KP Filaret died. He was 97 years old. The patriarch was buried today on the territory of the Volodymyr Cathedral. Archbishop Nikodym of Sumy and Okhtyr became the new patriarch of the UOC KP.  Photo: Getty Images / "Babel" @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇩🇰🇬🇱🇺🇸 In January, the Danish military sent explosives and blood supplies to Greenland in preparation for the US invasion, writes "Danish Radio" with reference to Danish, French and German sources.  The explosives were brought to, in particular, destroy runways, and the blood was for the wounded.  Denmark has begun working with European partners on a plan to gradually deploy troops on the island since the re-election of Donald Trump as US president. However, everything changed on January 3, when the United States invaded Venezuela and captured President Nicolás Maduro.  Danish, French, German, Norwegian and Swedish soldiers were immediately sent to the island under the guise of training. And in the North Atlantic - Danish fighters and a French ship.  ▪️On January 21, Trump announced for the first time that he would not use military force. However, at the same time, he said that no country except the United States is capable of guaranteeing the security of Greenland, that the United States wants to acquire the island, and called it "part of North America" ​​and "U.S. territory." Currently, the Americans want to conclude a new defense agreement with Greenland and Denmark to expand their military presence on the island.  Photo: Getty Images / "Babel" @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇰🇵 In the morning, the DPRK launched about ten ballistic missiles towards the Sea of ​​Japan.  North Korea has launched missiles for the third time in a year. Now it is associated with the fact that South Korea and the United States conduct annual spring military exercises "Shield of Freedom".  Recently, South Korean Prime Minister Kim Min-seok said that Donald Trump is positive about resuming dialogue with North Korean dictator Kim Jong-un. The statement came amid speculation that Trump may seek a meeting with Kim during his upcoming trip to China for a summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping.  @babel

author: Babel
text: In Odesa, a conductor died during evacuation from a train. She was hit by an oncoming train that was going to its evacuation stop.   Also, one of the passengers received moderate injuries. "Ukrzaliznytsia" began to investigate the accident.  In addition, the Russians attacked the locomotive of a suburban train on the Dnieper railway. There were no casualties here.  And in Sumy, the Russians attacked a brigade of rescuers who left on call because of the blows. The emergency services managed to leave, none of them were injured, only the fire truck was damaged.  In total, during the night, the Russian army launched 139 drones over Ukraine, anti-aircraft defense neutralized 127. Eight drones were hit in seven places, debris fell in another seven.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇭🇺 The drug that the Hungarian law enforcement officers injected into the Ukrainian tax collector is probably a relaxant: to make the person talk more during interrogations, writes The Guardian with reference to sources in the Ukrainian law enforcement agencies.  Earlier, the Ukrainian Foreign Ministry reported on this forced injection. After that, the diabetic man's blood sugar rose sharply, he developed hypertension and had to be hospitalized.  The Guardian writes that this collector is a former SBU employee. After the arrest, the tax and customs service of Hungary reported that the transportation of money was managed by a former general of the SBU and a former major of the Ukrainian Air Force.  Traces of the drug were detected during blood tests. The collectors' Hungarian lawyer, Lorant Horvath, confirmed that one of the men had received an unknown injection, while a Hungarian police source said he had heard from colleagues about the injection, but did not know what it contained.  @babel

author: Babel
text: Over the past year, Ukrainians have incurred more than half a million new debts. In total, their number reached 9.5 million, the Opendatabot service reports.  Among specific categories, the largest number of debts arose due to fines for traffic violations — more than 2 million proceedings (21%). Another 20% are other administrative offenses, and more than 8% are utility bills.  Dnipropetrovsk region traditionally has the most debts (over a million), followed by Kharkiv region, Kyiv, Odesa region and Donetsk region.  Infographic: "Opendatabot" @babel

author: Babel
text: Defense Express, citing sources, wrote that the drone that fell in the morning near the Independence Monument on the Maidan is a Russian "Lancet" with artificial intelligence.  Such drones are configured for use in swarms, autonomous navigation, target search and strike without communication with the operator.  At the same time, Serhiy "Flash" Beskrestnov, adviser to the Minister of Defense, writes that no Lancets can reach Kyiv. These are drones with a small amount of ammunition, which do not have enough battery life to fly such a distance.  Flash suggests that the occupiers deliberately dropped the wreckage of this drone from Shahed as part of an informational special operation.  @babel

author: Babel
text: The forces of unmanned systems shot down the Russian Ka-52 "Alligator" helicopter with an FPV drone.  This is a new generation reconnaissance and attack helicopter, a command vehicle of the army aviation, designed to destroy armored vehicles, manpower and air targets.  After the emergency landing, the crew tried to escape, but it was also eliminated by drones.  @babel

author: Babel
text: The US-Israeli operation against Iran could drag on until September, sources told Axios.  At first, it was expected that the operation would last 4-6 weeks - that is, until April 1 at the latest. However, Washington and its allies are now predicting a much longer timeframe, even if the intensity of the conflict subsides.  At the same time, Iranian officials have made it clear, both privately and publicly, that even if Trump decides to end the war, they can continue the shelling until they receive assurances that this is truly the end of the war and not just a temporary ceasefire.  @babel

author: Babel
text: The president of Iran confirmed the death of the country's intelligence minister Ismail Khatib.  Earlier today, Iran confirmed the death of the Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, Ali Larijani, and the commander of the Basij unit, Gholamreza Soleimani.  ⚫️ Since the start of hostilities, Israel has continued to kill key Iranian officials. In the first five minutes of the war, Israeli pilots killed Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and almost the entire military command of the country. Investigative journalist Ronen Bergman told how Israel succeeded, and "Babel" reported his words.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🚇 In "Ukrzaliznytsia", the American actor Sean Penn was presented with an "Oscar" made of the steel of a car damaged by the Russian attack.  The post noted that the actor was not without an Oscar, and thanked him for supporting Ukraine.  "This Oscar is not only about cinema. It is about stability, humanity and courage, which keeps us moving," the University noted.  ▪️The 98th Academy Awards ceremony took place in Los Angeles on March 15. Sean Penn missed the event to come to Ukraine. On March 16, it became known about his visit to Kyiv.   Video: ukrainianrailways / Instagram @babel

author: Babel
text: The SBU exposed a Russian information operation against Hungarians in Transcarpathia.  The law enforcement officers established that the perpetrators called representatives of the Hungarian community, threatened them and demanded that they leave Ukraine.  At the same time, they changed the number through IP-telephony so that it seemed as if the call was coming from Ukraine, and they presented themselves as "patriotic activists" or even law enforcement officers.  The SBU established that these calls actually came from the territory of the Russian Federation. Now the special service is blocking this operation.  @babel

author: Babel
text: A Russian A-50 aircraft was damaged during an attack on March 17. The plant in Alchevsk was also under attack, writes the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.  On March 17, Ukrainian troops struck the facilities of the 123rd aircraft repair plant in the city of Stara Russa (Novgorod region of the Russian Federation). At that moment, there was an A-50 aircraft in service there - probably waiting for modernization.  ﻿﻿﻿﻿And on March 20, the Alchevsk metallurgical plant in the Luhansk region came under attack. The enterprise manufactures shells of artillery shells, as well as manufactures and repairs armor for military equipment of the Russian army.  The troops also hit the Vostochny training ground in Novopetrivka in the occupied part of the Zaporizhzhia region.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇸🇮🇮🇱 Law enforcement officers in Slovenia claim that the private Israeli spy company Black Cube is interfering in Slovenian elections.  Parliamentary elections in the country will be held on Sunday. On them, the current prime minister, liberal Robert Golob, competes with the right-wing populist Yanez Janša, who previously headed the government four times.  Slovenia's intelligence and security agency has released a report saying Black Cube leaked records to link Prime Minister Robert Golob's government to corruption. The recordings show prominent Slovenian figures discussing corruption, illegal lobbying and misuse of public funds.  Opposition leader Jansha admitted that he met with Giora Eiland, the former head of Israel's National Security Council, who now works for Black Cube. And his party said that a monument should be erected to the company's employees.  Black Cube's past The company was founded in 2010 by former Israeli intelligence officers. Her circle of advisers included former Mossad directors Meir Dagan and Ephraim Halevi.  Black Cube became famous when it worked for sex offender and Hollywood producer Harvey Weinstein - when he was facing accusations. The company monitored journalists and female accusers.  In 2022, Romanian prosecutors charged Black Cube operatives, including CEO Zorella, with spying on the head of the anti-corruption bureau. The firm also attacked critics of Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇨🇳 China is preparing to buy Russian oil again after a break of several months, Reuters writes with reference to sources.  According to the agency, one of the country's largest energy companies, Sinopec and PetroChina, have already approached suppliers about possible purchases.   Despite rising prices due to the war between the US and Iran, Russian oil is still cheaper than alternatives, including from Brazil and West African countries.  Reuters sources say that the deals could be concluded in the near future, while the 30-day relaxation of sanctions is in effect. If the contracts are signed, it will be the first recovery in imports since November.  ▪️On March 12, the USA issued a 30-day exemption from sanctions for countries that buy Russian oil and oil products that are under restrictions and are currently stuck at sea.   @babel

author: Babel
text: Ukraine will boycott the closing ceremony of the Paralympic Games - Russians and Belarusians will be there under their flags.  The ceremony will start today at 21:30 Kyiv time.  Earlier, Ukraine boycotted the opening of the competition for the same reason. 15 countries joined the boycott, as well as officials of the European Union.  🗞 At this year's Paralympics, six Russian athletes competed under their own flag and anthem - for the first time since 2014. And for future competitions, the Russian Federation is preparing those who started playing sports after amputations due to participation in the war against Ukraine. "Babel" told the most important things about them.  @babel

author: Babel
text: There is no easier way to make any Army communications engineer jealous than to say, "But Flash wrote...". Flash is Sergey Beskrestnov, a media person.  163,000 people have subscribed to his open Telegram channel, and thousands of military personnel are in the closed groups he created. Serhiy Beskrestnov is both technical support, a source of news, and a center of expertise: for many years he has been working at the front, researching everything related to military communications, from ordinary radios to LTE control networks of Shaheds.  From the end of January 2025, he is an adviser to the Minister of Defense Mykhailo Fedorov and one of the faces of the new team of the ministry. Among other things, the military has its hopes in Serhii: they expect the Ministry of Defense to change for the better.  In an interview with Babel, Serhiy Beskrestnov talks about the five lives he lives: the life of a military man, an engineer, a corporation manager, an entrepreneur and (again) a military man. Watch the full version on YouTube or read the shortened version on the website.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 📚📖 "Orban has beaten the EU again - and maybe for the last time." World media about the Russian-Ukrainian war March 20 🖌"The city is sleeping. The crew of the patrol boat speeding through the dark waters of the Black Sea knows that it will not last long. In just 45 minutes, Odesa will be under continuous aerial bombardment. Ballistic missiles and drones are heading for the port they just left. Intelligence warns that this attack could be the biggest since the beginning of the year. For the captain of the cutter Ilya and his crew, this means one thing - they will be part of the last line of a multi-layered defense that tries to intercept the targets that sweep through the night sky. The task is extremely difficult. Using machine guns mounted on the nose and stern, the crew will try to shoot down enemy drones." This is how The Telegraph's article about the Ukrainian multi-level air defense system, which helps intercept drones, begins.   Defense forces combine various elements of protection: early detection of targets using a network of sensors and artificial intelligence to destroy them at different stages - in the air, on the approach to the city and already directly above the objects. Ukraine's experience in countering Russia's massive shelling — often larger than what Iran has so far carried out in the Persian Gulf — means it has something to offer the West in exchange for aid, the article says. "The trajectory of our interceptions is improving," says Commander Dmytro Pletenchuk, spokesman for the Ukrainian Navy. "The share of downed planes often reaches 90%."  🖌Viktor Orban outwitted the EU again and blocked a €90 billion loan for Ukraine. Despite 16 years of participation in European summits, this meeting may be his last, writes Politico. As the publication notes, Orban has been annoying Brussels for a long time, along with Paris, Berlin and other capitals. Before the meeting of the European Council, the EU prepared a compromise that would allow the Hungarian prime minister to save face during the election campaign and at the same time agree to a loan. It was about delaying the allocation of funds to Kyiv until the supply of Russian oil through the Druzhba pipeline is restored. "You have to treat Orbán like a six-year-old child, adapt to him," one diplomat told Politico.   If Orbán is re-elected — which one EU official said many leaders in the summit hall thought likely — then he may be more willing to approve the loan once oil is flowing again through the Druzhba pipeline. But if he does not do this, Hungary may be punished at the next meeting of EU leaders in Cyprus on April 23-24. Options include freezing funding, a lawsuit in the EU court, fines, and even the so-called nuclear option — the application of Article 7, which deprives the country of the right to vote in the European Union.  🗞This is only part of the review. For those who support us on Patreon, summaries of two more materials are available.  #inozmi @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇲🇩 The Parliament of Moldova voted in the first reading to leave the CIS, writes Moldpres.  The initiator was the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country. In particular, due to the fact that Russia violates the principles of the CIS on respect for the territorial integrity of Ukraine, Georgia and Moldova.  After the final withdrawal from the CIS, Moldova will save approximately $180,000 in annual contributions. At the same time, the country plans to maintain cooperation with the CIS countries in a bilateral format.  Over the past two years, Moldova has already canceled 71 out of 283 agreements within the CIS, 60 more are under consideration. The final decision on leaving the organization must be taken by the parliament in the second reading.  ▪️The CIS (Commonwealth of Independent States) is a regional international organization created in December 1991 after the collapse of the USSR to regulate relations between the former Soviet republics.  @babel

author: Babel
text: Reuters journalists learned the new name of the artist Banksy, under which he entered Ukraine in 2022. Now his name is David Jones.  A key role in the investigation was played by his murals near Kyiv, in particular in the village of Horenka. Journalists went there hoping that the locals would recognize one of the people they thought was potentially the real Banksy.  The "suspects" included French street artist Thierry Guetta, Massive Attack frontman Robert Del Naya and Bristol native Robin Gunningham.  Locals did not recognize any of them in the photo. But the following case was told: an ambulance drove up to the house, on which the image of a bearded man in a bathtub by Banksy later appeared. Three people came out of it, two of them were wearing masks. The third had only one arm and prostheses on both lower limbs.  The last one was Giles Dooley, a documentary photographer and founder of a charitable organization that, in particular, donates ambulances to Ukraine.  Later, journalists found out that Del Naya and a man named David Jones entered Ukraine together with Dooley in October 2022. It is this name, according to Reuters, that Banksy can now use. He changed his passport name for the purpose of conspiracy.  The artist himself and his team do not comment on these data.  Photo: Reuters @babel

author: Babel
text: 📚📖Despite the chronic shortage of infantry, Ukraine can still conduct successful offensive operations. World media about the war on March 17 🖌Ukraine is currently developing its own air defense system, similar to the Israeli "Iron Dome", says El Pais. The main problem is that the territory of Ukraine is about 30 times larger than that of Israel, so creating such a shield is much more difficult. This system should combine radars, anti-aircraft missiles, electronic warfare and interceptor drones, the article says. But the Ukrainian shield must be adapted to the country's own capabilities and cannot rely solely on expensive Western air defense systems such as Patriot or IRIS-T. "Our task is to build an anti-drone dome over Ukraine: a system that does not react after the fact, but destroys the threat as it approaches," Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov said in January.   🖌Financial Times publishes an article about the successes of the Ukrainian offensive at the front over the last month, despite the relatively small number of infantry. Ukrainian paratroopers and assault units advanced in the southeast — in the Zaporizhzhya and Dnipropetrovsk regions, and liberated several settlements. Last week, after a trip to the east, Volodymyr Zelenskyi said that Ukraine had recaptured approximately 400-435 sq. km of territory. Independent analysts give lower estimates and say that Kyiv may exaggerate some of the numbers, the publication notes. But they agree that the Ukrainian operation, which began at the beginning of February, really signals a real ability to repel Russian troops.  Several factors contributed to this at once: better planning of operations, use of elite units, mass use of drones, drone strikes on Russian equipment and logistics. Given this, there is every reason to believe that it may be more difficult for Russia to advance in 2026 than it was last year, says military analyst Rob Lee of the Institute for Foreign Policy Studies. But the coming months will not be easy for Kyiv either — the arrival of spring means the return of vegetation along the entire front line, which Russian assault groups use to hide from reconnaissance drones and advance deep into Ukrainian lines. In addition, Russian troops have almost captured Pokrovsk and Gulyaipole and are approaching Kramatorsk and Slovyansk, FT writes.  🗞This is only part of the review. For those who support us on Patreon, summaries of four more items are available.  #inozmi @babel

author: Babel
text: From March 20, Ukrainians will be able to receive partial compensation for fuel costs, Prime Minister Yulia Svyridenko announced.  We are talking about fuel purchased at gas stations participating in the programs. 15% cashback will be on diesel, 10% on gasoline, 5% on autogas.  This will save from 2 to 11 hryvnias per liter. The maximum amount of cashback on fuel is up to UAH 1,000 per person per month.  The program will work until May 1 within the framework of "National Cashback" — compensation will be calculated automatically when paying by card.   The money can be used to pay for utilities, medicine, Ukrainian-made products, books, postal services, or to support the Ukrainian military.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇺🇸🇮🇷 The US State Department offers a reward for information about the new leader of Iran and top officials of the regime - up to $10 million. The wanted list includes ten high-ranking Iranian officials, but only six of them are named. These include, in particular, the new supreme leader Mojtab Khamenei, the head of his administration Ali Asghar Hejazi, the secretary of the Supreme National Security Council of Iran Ali Larijani, and the Minister of Intelligence Ismail Khatib.  The US State Department also offers a reward for information about the leaders of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), but does not specify their names.  Photo: Rewards for Justice / X @babel

entities.text: Supreme National Security Council of Iran

author: Babel
text: 🇩🇪🇯🇵 Germany and Japan agreed to expand military cooperation.  Defense Ministers Borys Pistorius and Shinjiro Koizumi met today in Japan. Pistorius said that Berlin offers to sign the Mutual Access Agreement. Such agreements allow partner countries to more easily deploy troops on each other's territory for training, exercises or operations.  Since 2022, Japan has signed such agreements with Great Britain and Australia, is finalizing the signing with France and is negotiating with Canada.  The countries also agreed to make a joint contribution to freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, for example, in the field of mine clearance. However, they will join only after the ceasefire.  ▪️Previously, the leaders of Great Britain, France, Italy, the Netherlands and Canada also declared their readiness to participate in unblocking the Strait of Hormuz. However, also only after the end of hostilities.  Photo: Getty Images / "Babel" @babel

author: Babel
text: At night, the Russians launched 147 attack drones over Ukraine. Ukrainian air defense shot down 128 of them.  15 drones fell in 12 places, debris fell in three more.  🔴 Kharkiv region. The occupiers attacked the village of Zolochiv in Bogoduhiv district. Five people were injured.  🔴Odeszine The object of critical infrastructure was under attack. There were no casualties.  🔴 Chernihiv region. The occupiers attacked the locomotive - the driver and his assistant were injured.  🔴Daughter. The Russians attacked Kramatorsk with high-explosive aerial bombs. Eight people were injured, including two children. More than 30 private houses and two apartment buildings were damaged.  Photo 3: Ministry of Development of Communities and Territories of Ukraine / Facebook @babel

entities.text: Ministry of Development of Communities and Territories of Ukraine

author: Babel
text: 🇮🇷 The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Iran, Abbas Aragchi, said that Russia and China help his country in various ways, including military.  Aragchi called Russia and China strategic partners of Tehran during the war with the USA and Israel. Iran has had close political, economic and military cooperation with them in the past and continues to this day.  ▪️At the beginning of March, WP wrote that Russia is giving Iran data on the location of US troops in the Middle East. CNN later reported that the Russian Federation is also sharing drone tactics with Iran.  ▪️On March 13, US President Donald Trump said that Russia "might be helping Iran a little" because the US is helping Ukraine.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 💥 At night, the Naval Forces of the Ukrainian Armed Forces, together with other units, attacked an enterprise servicing the Russian air defense system.  We are talking about the Innovation Center of the "Granit" enterprise, which is part of the "Almaz-Antey" concern. In particular, the concern maintains equipment that forms the basis of the anti-aircraft "shield" of Crimea. Most often, the S-400 "Triumph", S-300 "Favourite", "Buk" and "Tor" air defense systems, as well as radar stations, are repaired there.  In addition, the Navy attacked a concentration of Russian troops near Sevastopol's Rifle Bay, and the General Staff reports that Ukrainian troops attacked: 🔴munitions warehouses in Donetsk region and Kherson region; 🔴fuel warehouse in Kherson region; 🔴 places of concentration of Russians in Donetsk region and Crimea.  @babel

entities.text: Naval Forces of the Ukrainian Armed Forces

author: Babel
text: In the United States, the director of the National Counterterrorism Center, Joe Kent, is resigning in protest of the war in Iran.  “I cannot in good conscience support the ongoing war in Iran. Iran did not pose a direct threat to our country, and it is clear that we started this war under pressure from Israel and its powerful American lobby," he said.  Photo: Getty Images @babel

author: Babel
text: 🥈 Ukraine received its last medal at this year's Paralympics.  Oleksandr Kazik won silver in the 20 km ski race for the visually impaired. He was 8.2 seconds behind winner Jack Edikoff of the United States.  This is the athlete's third medal at the 2026 Paralympics. He previously won gold and silver in two parabiathlon events.  ▪️This year at the Paralympic Games, Ukraine took seventh place with 19 medals: three gold and eight silver and bronze. However, in terms of the total number of medals, Ukraine is third. China is in first place.  In the photo Oleksandr Kazik and his guide Serhiy Kucheryavy: National Paralympic Committee of Ukraine / Facebook @babel

author: Babel
text: More than two weeks have passed since the US-Israeli operation against Iran. Here is what is known as of now: 🔴Since February 28, the American military has destroyed more than 100 ships of the Iranian fleet and carried out more than 6,000 sorties, the US Central Command reported.  🔴In response to the March 11 shelling by Iran-backed Hezbollah, Israel launched a ground operation in Lebanon. The Israeli army attacked the main targets of Hezbollah in the south of the country, the IDF said.  🔴 Today, Israel liquidated the space satellite center in the capital of Iran, Tehran, where military programs were developed, writes CNN. The IDF announced that it also destroyed the plane of the deceased supreme leader of Iran, Ali Khamenei.  🔴 US President Donald Trump said on the evening of March 15 that he is not ready to declare victory in the war against Iran. However, he said that Iran's recovery from the US strikes will take at least a decade, writes the Hill.  🔴Iranian drones attacked the oil hub in the United Arab Emirates - the port of Fujairah, a fire broke out there. And also the airport in Dubai, writes CNBC.  On the video - Iran's attack on the port of Fujairah @babel

author: Babel
text: The Russians launched 68 missiles and 430 drones over Ukraine overnight. Air defense shot down 460 targets, in particular: 🔴one of the two anti-ship missiles "Zirkon"; 🔴7 out of 13 "Iskander-M" / S-400 ballistic missiles;  🔴all 25 Kalibr cruise missiles; 🔴all 24 Kh-101 cruise missiles; 🔴one of 4 guided air missiles X-59/69; 🔴402 out of 430 strike drones.  The main direction of the attack was Kyiv region — 4 people were killed there, 15 were injured. The Russians also fought in Zaporizhzhya district, where 4 people were wounded, including two children (photos 1-2).  Also that night, a Russian drone hit a suburban train in the Kharkiv region. The driver and his assistant were injured (photos 3-5).  @babel

author: Babel
text: Archbishop Nikodym of Sumy and Okhtyr was elected as the new patriarch of the UOC KP.  He was elected at an extraordinary council of the Ukrainian Orthodox Church of the Kyiv Patriarchate, which was attended by seven bishops, he announced on his Facebook page.  He also emphasized that the bishops keep the UOC KP as an independent institution and will not join any other church structures.  ▪️Honorary Patriarch Filaret of Kyiv died yesterday at the age of 97. He led the UOC KP since 1995.  Photo: Archbishop Nikodym of Sumy / Facebook @babel

author: Babel
text: The war between Israel, the USA and Iran lasts 19 days. "Babel" collected the main information about the region this morning.  🔴Additional troops. Reuters, citing sources, writes that the White House is considering a plan to send thousands more American troops to the region. The next steps of the US may include a sea and air mission to unblock the Strait of Hormuz.  The White House is also discussing the possibility of deploying troops on the coast of Iran, landing them on the Iranian island of Kharg (the main export hub of Iranian oil), and seizing Iran's reserves of highly enriched uranium.  🔴Unknown drones. WP, citing sources, writes that in Washington, unknown drones flew over the Fort McNair base, where Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio live. This prompted officials to consider the relocation of high-ranking officials, but they refuse to relocate.  🔴Attacks on gas infrastructure. In the morning, Iran attacked Qatar's largest gas field, the industrial city of Ras Lafan. Yesterday, Israel struck Iran's South Pars gas field.  Donald Trump said that Israel attacked without warning the US. He added that Israel will no longer attack these facilities. However, if Iran decides to attack a country, the USA will destroy the entire gas field even without Israel's help.  However, Israeli journalist Axios Barak Ravid, citing American and Israeli sources, writes that Trump knew in advance about the Israeli strike and gave it the green light.  In the photo of Tehran: Getty Images / "Babel" @babel

author: Babel
text: On the night of March 15-16, the 98th Academy Awards ceremony will begin in Los Angeles.   There are no Ukrainian nominees this year, the favorites are the vampire musical "Sinners", the drama "Battle by Battle" and the biopic "Marty Supreme".  "Babel" editors are not going to watch the ceremony (we apologize), and on Monday morning they will not discuss the laureates, but look at the dresses on the red carpet.   Correspondent Valeriya Tsuba and art director Nastya Lysytsia, who adore fashion, have collected the most subjective selection of the most beautiful dresses in which actresses have paraded on the Oscar red carpet for the past four years. Elegance, extravagance and sky-high price tags. We admire  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇿🇲 In Zambia, political parties demand sexual favors from women who want to become candidates in the elections, the BBC writes.  The head of the Gender Equality Department in the President's Administration, Mainga Kabika, said that some of these cases have already been documented.   Beauty Katebe, head of the Coordinating Council of Gender Organizations, said that this practice discourages women from participating in politics.  She also called for the creation of a special court to quickly deal with such cases and to strengthen legislation to protect women.  ▪️According to the authorities, in Zambia only 28% of management positions in the civil service are held by women, and among 36 heads of state-owned enterprises, there are only five of them.  @babel

author: Babel
text: Donald Trump said that Volodymyr Zelensky is the last person from whom the United States needs help.  This is how he reacted to the Ukrainian president's offer to help American troops and their allies in the Middle East intercept Iranian drones.  At the same time, he refused to comment on whether the United States accepted Ukraine's help with drone interception technology.  Asked about his decision to temporarily lift some sanctions on Russian oil, Trump said: “I want the world to have oil. I want to have oil." He added that sanctions will be reinstated "as soon as the crisis passes."  When asked about criticism from some foreign leaders over the lifting of sanctions, Trump did not answer directly, instead criticizing Zelensky: “I'm surprised that Zelensky doesn't want to make a deal. Tell Zelensky to make a deal, because Putin is ready for a deal."  Cartoon: Christian Adams / The Telegraph @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇺🇸 In the USA, the scientist Monica Reza, connected to the missing General William McCasland and legends about UFOs, has disappeared, the New York Post writes.  Reza, 60, disappeared on June 22, 2025, while hiking in the Los Angeles National Forest on the popular Mount Waterman Trail. Despite months of search operations, she still has not been found.  Monika created a nickel-based superalloy, Mondaloy. It was this alloy that was financed by the laboratory led by McCasland, who disappeared under similar circumstances in February.  This comes days after US President Donald Trump ordered the release of government documents related to alien and extraterrestrial life.  ▪️McCasland commanded the Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, which is associated with stories about UFOs due to the Roswell incident. In 1947, in Roswell, the military reported the fall of a weather balloon. In the 1970s, Lt. Col. Jesse Marcel claimed that the debris was of extraterrestrial origin. Since then, there have been legends that it was at the Wright-Patterson base that alien debris was hidden.  @babel

author: Babel
text: Drones attacked a number of energy facilities in several Russian cities.  An oil depot was under attack in Tikhoretsk (Krasnodar Territory), and a fire broke out on its territory. High-voltage lines were also damaged. This city is home to one of the largest oil hubs in southern Russia.  The drones also attacked Belgorod's energy supply, which is why the city has problems with electricity, water and heat. And in the Crimea, the Tavriyskaya TPP near Simferopol was under attack.  Explosions rang out in Volgograd, namely in the areas where the Lukoil refinery and the power plant are located. Drones also flew to Saransk, in the Republic of Mordovia, the consequences are still unknown.  In total, at least 170 drones were launched across Russia that night, and they were spotted in 13 regions. In particular, 20 UAVs flew to Moscow.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 💥 At night, the Ukrainian military attacked military facilities in Russia and the occupied territories.  🔴In Bryansk region, the TOR-M2U air defense system came under attack. 🔴 In Crimea, there is a missile division of the 15th separate coastal missile brigade of the Black Sea Fleet of the Russian Federation. 🔴 Donetsk region is a hub of communication and concentration of the military. 🔴In Zaporizhzhia - a fuel warehouse in Melitopol, ammunition warehouses and drone control points. 🔴In Kherson Oblast, there is an educational and training center for drone operators.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇭🇺🇪🇺 Hungary demands that the EU suspend all tariffs on fertilizers from Russia and Belarus, because the war in the Middle East may increase world food prices.  Fertilizers are rising in price due to the fact that Iran blocks the Strait of Hormuz: supplies of fuel and raw materials necessary for their production are reduced.  The EU raised tariffs on Russian and Belarusian fertilizers last year, as their imports have increased in recent years. This has raised concerns that Russia, instead of selling the sanctioned gas for export, is sending it to the production of fertilizers and exporting them.  @babel

author: Babel
text: ⚡️ NABU claims that their employee was detained by SBU officers.  It happened at the checkpoint near the entrance to Sumy. The detainee was in the city on an official assignment within the scope of the investigation.  NABU claims that probably the SBU employees were from the unit coordinated by the first deputy head of the SBU, Oleksandr Poklad, that is, the counterintelligence department.  One of the reasons for the detention is that the parents of the NABU employee live in the temporarily occupied territories. NABU states that he passed all the necessary checks.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇮🇷 Iran has officially confirmed the death of the Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council Ali Larijani and the commander of the "Basij" unit Golamreza Soleimani.  The Israeli military announced their elimination yesterday. Larijani was the right-hand man of Iran's former Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. He was responsible for negotiations on major issues of national security, including the nuclear program.  For six years, Soleimani headed the Basij unit, a paramilitary organization that consists of volunteers, performs the function of the people's militia and participates in violent dispersal of demonstrations in the country.  🗞 Since the beginning of hostilities, Israel has continued to kill key Iranian officials. Thus, in the first five minutes of the war, Israeli pilots killed the supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and almost the entire military command of the country. Investigative journalist Ronen Bergman told how Israel succeeded, and "Babel" reported his words.  Photo: Getty Images / "Babel" @babel

author: Babel
text: ⚡️ The honorary patriarch of the OCU Filaret died. He was 97 years old.  Filaret headed the Ukrainian Orthodox Church of the Kyiv Patriarchate since 1995. After the creation of the autocephalous Orthodox Church of Ukraine in 2018, he received the title of honorary patriarch.  But later, Filaret and the remnants of the UOC-KP claimed that the council at which the decision to dissolve the UOC-KP was not valid. Filaret accused Metropolitan Epiphany and the then President Petro Poroshenko of not fulfilling the agreements, liquidating the Kyiv Patriarchate and said that he was supposed to lead the church.  The case reached the court - then the Supreme Court refused Filaret to invalidate the Local Council, during which the OCU was formed.  🗞 In 1990, Filaret temporarily headed the Russian Orthodox Church, after the death of Patriarch Pymen. He had good chances to occupy the patriarchal throne, but he lost the election and began to fight for the Ukrainian church. Read more about this in the text of "Babel" about the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra.  Photo: Patriarch Filaret / Facebook @babel

author: Babel
text: Actor and director Sean Penn came to Kyiv instead of Oscar.  He was supposed to be in Los Angeles tonight to pick up his third statuette, for Best Supporting Actor for One Battle After Another.  However, he went to Ukraine and already met with President Zelensky — the President's Office informed about this.  In 2022, the actor gave one of his previous "Oscars" to Zelensky before the end of the war - as a "symbol of faith in the victory of Ukraine."  Video: Ukrainianrailways / Instagram @babel

author: Babel
text: 🥉 Oleksandra Kononova took bronze at the Winter Paralympics in cross-country skiing.  The Ukrainian finished third in the 20 km freestyle standing class.  Three more representatives of Ukraine took part in the competition: Lyudmila Lyashenko (4), Iryna Bui (5) and Bohdana Konashuk (9).  @babel

author: Babel
text: From next week, over-the-counter medicines will be sold at gas stations, Prime Minister Yulia Svyridenko announced.  According to her, 15 licenses have already been issued, and another 43 applications are in the works. Control is provided by the State Health Service.  The Cabinet of Ministers allowed the sale of over-the-counter medicines at gas stations as early as December 26. The goal is to lower drug prices and make them more affordable.  @babel

author: Babel
text: Suspicions of bribery were announced to the deputy heads of the SBU in Kyiv region and Rivne region.  According to the investigation, they demanded $620,000 from the head of the monopoly company in the amber business. For this amount, they promised to close the criminal proceedings that had previously been opened against his company. Now they face 8 to 12 years in prison.  A civilian who was an intermediary was also charged with two counts of bribery.  @babel

author: Babel
text: In March 2026, the president, the head of the government, and the head of the State Agency for Reconstruction and Development of Infrastructure, Serhiy Sukhomlin, simultaneously spoke about bad roads, which were previously actively discussed in social networks.  General conclusion: everything is very bad with the roads, but there is no money for high-quality repairs. 52 billion hryvnias are needed for low-quality pit food: 12.6 billion will be taken from the Ministry of Development program in the state budget; 10 billion from the reserve fund. The Ministry of Defense should help with repairs in the frontline regions. Key routes are planned to be patched in a few months - by June 1.  Will the repaired roads survive the next winter, who is to blame for the fact that now it is necessary to overpay for repairs, did the roads of the "Great Construction" come down with snow and why it was not possible to protect the energy industry from missiles - a long interview with the founder and head of the "Avtostrada" group of companies Maksym Shkil.  @babel

entities.text: State Agency for Reconstruction and Development of Infrastructure

author: Babel
text: The first trailer for the movie "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" has appeared. This is already the fourth solo film about Peter Parker in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.  Brand New Day continues the story of the previous film and shows a world where no one remembers that Peter is Spider-Man, not even his girlfriend MJ (Zendaya) and best friend Ned (Jacob Batalon).  The film will be released in Ukrainian cinemas on July 30.  @babel

author: Babel
text: Sri Lanka declares Wednesday a holiday as the country prepares for fuel shortages due to the war in the Middle East.  All state institutions, including schools and universities, will have a day off. At the same time, it will not be received by health and immigration authorities.  The authorities chose Wednesday instead of Friday as an additional day off so that state institutions would not be closed for three days in a row.  Also, drivers are now required to register for a special pass, which limits the amount of fuel purchased. Local residents complain about too low quotas: 15 liters for private cars and five liters for motorcycles.  ▪️Asian countries are actively introducing cost-saving measures, since the war in the Middle East actually stopped traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. Almost 90% of all oil and gas was transported to Asia last year.  @babel

author: Babel
text: On March 17, Ukraine struck the Russian aircraft repair plant in the city of Stara Russa, Novgorod region.  The enterprise specializes in the repair and modernization of military transport aircraft and components for them. The plant has its own runway, which allows you to receive heavy aircraft directly on the territory of the enterprise.  The hangar for servicing Il-76 and L-410 aircraft was under attack.  @babel

author: Babel
text: A tanker with Russian fuel changed course from Cuba to Trinidad and Tobago after the US ban, writes Bloomberg.  It is about the tanker Sea Horse, which is probably carrying almost 200,000 barrels of Russian diesel fuel and changed course on Friday.  Another tanker continues its journey across the Atlantic Ocean towards the port of Matanzas in Cuba. Last month, the tanker suddenly suspended traffic due to restrictions on access to Cuban ports.  ▪️The day before, the Russian Federation sent two oil and gas tankers to Cuba against the backdrop of the US energy blockade. After that, the US Treasury officially added Cuba to the list of countries prohibited from receiving Russian oil.  @babel

author: Babel
text: At night, the Russians launched 156 attack drones over Ukraine. Ukrainian air defense shot down 133 of them.   19 drones were hit in 13 places, debris fell in seven more. What is known about the consequences: 🔴Odesa. The occupiers attacked the seaport — two commercial vessels under the flags of Palau and Barbados (pictured), a grain bunker, administrative buildings and port equipment were damaged.  🔴Dnipropetrovsk region. Two men were injured in the Synelnyk region, one of them was hospitalized in a moderate condition.  🔴 Zaporozhye. A woman died in the Zaporizhzhia district. A man and a ten-year-old boy were injured.  Photo: Oleg Kiper / Odesa OVA @babel

author: Babel
text: "If you don't serve the state in the parliament, serve the state at the front." Volodymyr Zelenskyy is ready to discuss changes to the law on mobilization.  "People's deputies will either have to serve in the parliament according to Ukrainian legislation, or I am ready to discuss with the representatives of the parliament the law regarding changes to the mobilization so that the deputies can go to the front," the president said at a closed meeting with journalists, as quoted by Interfax-Ukraine.   Among his other statements: 🔴The American military contacted the Ukrainian military with a request for expertise in countering Shahed. "The Americans attacked us several times. We received letters, calls and requests from all military institutions. We responded to them."  🔴Zelensky would like to sign a drone agreement with the USA "for years" - worth about $35-50 billion. Ukraine is also ready for joint production. Distribution — 50% Ukrainian engineers, 50% American. In peacetime, if the US needs a larger quantity, it will have first priority for the entire volume. The same applies to Ukraine.   🔴There is a risk for providing Ukraine with anti-aircraft missiles. As an alternative, Ukraine is considering the European SAMP/T systems and agrees to be the first in line for them in case of successful anti-ballistic tests.  🔴Individual Ukrainian manufacturers sold interceptor drones abroad without the knowledge of the state. Zelenskyy emphasized: foreign partners should not buy individual drones, but a full-fledged defense system together with Ukrainian expertise in its use.  🔴The restoration of the Druzhba oil pipeline is no different from the lifting of sanctions from the Russian Federation. "The question is more global: we sell Russian oil or we don't sell it. Because they are forcing me to restore "Friendship". How does this differ from the lifting of sanctions against the Russians?"  🔴The USA offered to postpone the tripartite meeting to next week due to the situation in the Middle East. The USA is ready to host the meeting, Ukraine agrees, but the Russian side is not ready to fly to the USA.  @babel

author: Babel
text: VAKS chose preventive measures in the case of bribes to two suspected SBU officials and an accomplice, Suspilne writes.  Civilian Andrii Avdievskyi, whom the investigation considers a mediator in the case, was taken into custody for 60 days - until May 4, with a bail of UAH 998,400.   Oleg Tokarchuk, the deputy head of the SBU in Kyiv and the region, was also given bail in the amount of UAH 998,400.  Also, VAKS arrested Ihor Brik, deputy director of the SBU in the Rivne region, for two months with a bail of 998,000.  ▪️The day before, the law enforcement officers informed them about the suspicions. According to the case file, Tokarchuk, together with Brik, through the intermediary of Avdievsky, demanded more than $620,000 from the amber company for a promise to close the criminal proceedings against the businessman.   @babel

author: Babel
text: At night, the Russians launched 133 attack drones over Ukraine. Air defense of Ukraine shot down 109 of them.   20 drones were hit in 11 places, debris fell in seven more. What is known about the consequences: 🔴Odesa. The occupiers attacked Primorsky, Kyiv and Khadzhibey districts of the city. Previously, three people were injured.  🔴Dnipropetrovsk region. A 57-year-old woman was injured in the Sinelnykiv Oblast. The enemy also attacked Nikopolshchyna and Kryvyi Rih.  🔴 Zaporozhye. In the morning, the occupiers attacked the infrastructure of the regional center. Previously, one man was injured, he is in serious condition. More than 40,000 subscribers lost power.  @babel

author: Babel
text: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy signed the law on combating discrimination and sexual harassment in the military.  The military is prohibited from allowing or tolerating discrimination based on gender, race, religion, origin, social status or place of residence.  If a member of the military becomes aware of such incidents, he or she must notify the appropriate unit or gender advisor.  Commanders must immediately arrest a subordinate if he commits or attempts to commit a crime against sexual freedom.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇪🇺 The EU Council has extended personal sanctions against Russians involved in the war against Ukraine for another six months.  The list includes 2,600 individuals and legal entities. They are banned from entering the EU, their assets are frozen, and EU residents cannot transfer funds to them.  The Council of the EU decided not to renew the sanctions against two people, and also excluded the five dead from the list.  It is not specified who exactly it is about.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 🇮🇷 Iran informed the IAEA that yesterday evening a projectile hit the territory of the Bushehr nuclear power plant - it is being built together with Rosatom.  There are no reports of damage to the station and no casualties.  "Rosatom" writes that this is the first strike on this nuclear power plant since the beginning of the war. In two weeks, the Russians reduced the staff at the second and third reactors (they are currently under construction) and evacuated 250 workers and their families. About 480 Russians remain there now.  Screenshot: Google Maps @babel

author: Babel
text: 🔥 On the night of March 21, the Ukrainian military attacked the Saratov oil refinery.  Previously, the oil secondary processing plant and the vertical tank RVS-10000 were damaged.  This enterprise processes oil and produces fuels and lubricants that are used for the needs of the Russian army.  The Saratov Refinery is one of the oldest oil refining enterprises in Russia. As of 2023, the amount of processing was 4.8 million tons.   @babel

author: Babel
text: The EU imposed sanctions against 4 pro-Russian propagandists and 9 Russian military personnel involved in crimes in Buch.  The first list included: propagandist of "Solovyev.live" Serhii Klyuchenkov; the host of the "Vesti" program on "Russia-1" Ernest Matskievičius; British blogger and propagandist who worked for RT and the Russian Ministry of Defense channel "Zvezda" Graham Phillips and French pseudo-expert Adrien Boquet.  The second package includes high-ranking military officials who commanded Russian troops in Ukraine at the beginning of the aggression. Among them is Colonel-General Oleksandr Chayko, the former commander of the Eastern Military District. He was the commander-in-chief of the Russians in Ukraine when Russian troops entered Bucha.   The list also includes a military man who adopted an illegally deported Ukrainian child.  @babel

author: Babel
text: At Diya, a beta test of a new category in the Register of Losses — job loss due to the aggression of the Russian Federation — has begun.  Ukrainians who worked or were self-employed and lost their jobs from February 24, 2022 due to the war can protest the service. We are talking about: 🔴hired employees (under an employment contract or contract); 🔴specialists who worked under civil law contracts; 🔴self-employed persons; 🔴people who worked under an oral contract or under the terms of an implicitly expressed agreement.  To participate in testing, you will need an identification code and e-mail. The system will pull part of the information from electronic registers, and the rest must be entered manually. You can join the test by following the link.  @babel

author: Babel
text: 💥 Meanwhile, in the Krasnodar region of the Russian Federation, the Afip Refinery is on fire after a drone attack.  This object was repeatedly attacked by Ukrainian drones. The oil refinery produces gasoline and diesel fuel and supplies them to the Russian army.   In the same region of the Russian Federation, the port of Kavkaz was under attack at night. There is a damaged ship. The General Staff announced the casualties.  Explosions also rang out in Tolyatti, Samara Region of the Russian Federation — locals report an attack on the KuibyshevAzot chemical plant, which was already attacked on March 11.  In the footage - Afipskiy Refinery @babel

author: Babel
text: The SBU press service responded to NABU's statement about the detention of an employee of the bureau.  They explained that during the check at the checkpoint, they found that the detainee came from the temporarily occupied territories, he did not name his place of work, he showed only a page from "Diya" from the documents, and several Russian numbers were found among his contacts.  Therefore, the Security Service employees decided to conduct an enhanced inspection.  @babel

author: Babel
text: The US has temporarily allowed the sale of Iranian oil that is already at sea.   About 140 million barrels are in question - they are planned to be quickly brought to world markets to lower prices and stabilize supplies.  At the same time, new production or purchases are prohibited, and Iran's access to revenues will be limited. text: Putin offered Trump to transfer stocks of enriched uranium from Iran to Russia, writes Axios.  It is about 450 kg of uranium enriched to 60%. This amount would be enough to create more than 10 nuclear warheads. Therefore, control over these uranium reserves is one of the key military goals of the US and Israel.  In theory, Russia's proposal could help remove nuclear material from Iran without US or Israeli involvement on the ground. Moscow already stored Iran's low-enriched uranium as part of the 2015 nuclear deal.  However, Trump did not support this idea. The US official said the US position is to make sure the uranium is protected.  Russia has put forward similar proposals before, during the negotiations between the United States and Iran regarding the nuclear program in 2025. Then Iran refused to hand over the uranium and offered to dilute it at its facilities under IAEA control.  At the same time, the US and Israel are considering various options for controlling Iran's uranium, including Tehran's voluntary relinquishment of its stockpiles.   @babel

text: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Ukraine has a complete air defense system, except for anti-ballistic capabilities, in an interview with New York Post.  He noted that the United States has advanced anti-ballistic systems, and combining these capabilities could make it possible to fully protect the airspace of any country.  “Thousands of Patriot missile system missiles cannot stop tens of thousands of Iranian Shahed drones. One such drone is about 40 times cheaper than a Patriot missile. In terms of production time and cost, it is impossible to compete with drones. There simply will not be enough resources.  In the long term, drones have no distance limits. Today they fly 100 km, tomorrow 1,000, and the day after tomorrow 10,000. That is why modern defense must be developed.  Today, Ukraine is number one in these technologies, and the United States has the most effective and powerful army in the world. If we are talking about an exchange — a real exchange of security, guarantees, and experience — we are open. This is a real partnership offer.  An interceptor drone costs $3,000–5,000. One Shahed costs about $10,000, while a Patriot missile costs $4 million. Ukraine spends about $10,000 to shoot down a drone, while a Middle Eastern country spends $4 million. author: United24Media
text: Fuel oil prices in Singapore have risen by 146% since the beginning of the year, surpassing the peaks of 2008 and the 2022 energy crisis.  The price of this fuel in Singapore, one of the world’s largest hubs, has reached about $140 per barrel. It is a key indicator for global logistics, as it fuels container ships, tankers, and most maritime fleets.  The sharp increase is driven by the war in the Middle East and disruptions to supplies through the Strait of Hormuz, one of the main routes for global oil and gas trade. Any restrictions or risks in this region immediately affect fuel and shipping costs.  The rise in fuel oil prices directly increases maritime shipping costs, which are eventually passed on to the prices of all goods, from electronics to food. This is essentially inflation that “sails” across the sea.  The market is already reacting. Carriers are raising rates, and businesses are beginning to reassess their supply chains. If the situation in the region does not stabilize, price increases could accelerate and hit the global economy harder than during the 2022 crisis, media reports say.

text: The International Paralympic Committee is investigating a possible “rule violation” by German athletes who refused to stand together with Russians during the awards ceremony, The Athletic reports. After the Russian athlete’s victory, the Russian anthem was played during the ceremony. At that moment, Kazmaier and her guide Florian Baumann turned their backs on the Russians. We also know many Ukrainian athletes and had good conversations with some of them. They told us what is happening to their families and loved ones. It was the only right thing to do. text: A court in Poland has agreed to extradite Russian archaeologist Alexander Butyagin to Ukraine. He is wanted by Ukraine for conducting excavations in Russian-occupied Crimea. The decision can still be appealed.  Butyagin was detained in December 2025 in a Warsaw hotel during a lecture tour in Europe. Ukraine then filed an extradition request.  Russia summoned the Polish ambassador over the detention and protested against his extradition to Ukraine.

author: United24Media
text: Filaret, the 97-year-old Patriarch of the Ukrainian Orthodox Church of the Kyiv Patriarchate, has passed away. He had previously been hospitalized due to deteriorating health.

author: United24Media
text: Border guards of the “Steel Border” brigade destroyed two vehicles, two field ammunition depots, an FPV launch point, a mortar, and two shelters.

author: United24Media
text: ❗️Egypt is imposing energy-saving measures nationwide amid the regional impact of the war involving Iran.  Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly said that starting March 28, shopping malls, restaurants, and shops will close at 9 p.m. on weekdays and 10 p.m. on weekends.  Other measures include switching off billboards, reducing street lighting, shortening the working hours of government agencies to 6 p.m., and considering remote work several days a week.

author: United24Media
text: A Greek-flagged tanker was attacked near the Russian port of Novorossiysk in the Black Sea on Saturday morning, Greek Shipping Minister Vassilis Kikilias said.  Speaking to the Greek state broadcaster ERT, Kikilias said the crew of 24 sailors — including 10 Greeks, 13 Filipinos and one Romanian — were unharmed. The tanker, which sustained only material damage in the attack, was chartered by Chevron.  According to the shipping ministry, the vessel Maran Homer had departed from Thessaloniki and was heading for Novorossiysk, according to data from MarineTraffic.  Kikilias said the attack could be linked to a US decision to temporarily exempt Russian oil from sanctions. He added that he had informed Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis and Foreign Minister Giorgos Gerapetritis about the incident.  According to the minister, Greece may raise the issue at the European Council level if necessary, calling the attack on ships flying the Greek flag or carrying a Greek crew “unacceptable and extremely dangerous.”  Ukraine has not commented on the report of the attack on the Greek tanker.

author: United24Media
text: “During the meetings, we focused on reliable security guarantees and the humanitarian track, in particular the exchange and return of our citizens. We have made progress in aligning positions and further narrowing the range of unresolved issues,” said Secretary of the National Security and Defense Council Rustem Umerov following the latest round of negotiations with the American side in Florida.  For his part, U.S. Presidential Special Representative Steve Witkoff said:  “The constructive talks built on yesterday’s progress and focused on key points for establishing a strong and reliable security system for Ukraine, as well as on critically important humanitarian efforts in the region.”

author: United24Media
text: 🦾 Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Ukrainian forces had foiled a Russian offensive that was planned to begin in March.  “Our guys are just great. The fact that they foiled the offensive planned by the Russians is a fact. The offensive was supposed to take place in early spring, specifically in March. The Russians failed. There were many attempts. The guys foiled it. Just great,” the President said.

author: United24Media
text: Russia has increased its military support for Iran amid the war in the Middle East, according to The Wall Street Journal.  According to the report, this includes the transfer of satellite imagery, intelligence, and components for upgraded Shahed systems to improve navigation and guidance.  In addition, Russia is advising Iran on drone tactics, drawing on its experience from the war against Ukraine—specifically on the scale of drone use in attacks and the altitudes at which they are deployed. Analysts note that Iran’s strikes have already begun to resemble Russian tactics.  Such support, although limited, significantly enhances Iran’s capabilities for precision strikes against military targets, the report says.

author: United24Media
text: Border guards conducting aerial reconnaissance from the “Phoenix” unit of the “Pomsta” brigade used FPV drones to strike Russian positions.  One of the occupiers attempted to return fire but was eliminated by the drone operator.

author: United24Media
text: Oleksandr Usyk and Anthony Joshua arrived in Kyiv together.  This is the Briton’s first visit to Ukraine since the full-scale invasion began.  “Already planning a short tour of the city. I can’t wait to show you some of my favorite places!” Usyk wrote.

author: United24Media
text: ❗️Russian strike on Druzhba: Naftogaz head meets Macron and provides “exhaustive information” on the oil pipeline’s condition.  They discussed the scale of the destruction, the progress of the recovery work, and the current technical condition of the facility after the attack, Serhii Koretsky reported following the meeting between French President Emmanuel Macron and the Ukrainian delegation led by the prime minister.  According to him, France confirmed its intention to continue supporting Ukraine’s energy sector.  The meeting also addressed Ukraine’s efforts to strategically transform the energy sector and the implementation of the Regional Energy Sustainability Plans, which the Cabinet of Ministers is carrying out together with regions and communities.  Koretsky added that Naftogaz is interested in deepening cooperation with French energy companies and equipment manufacturers.

author: United24Media
text: Ukraine is gradually shifting the war onto Russian territory, striking the military infrastructure that helps Russia wage its war.  Russia responds in its usual way—by launching chaotic attacks on civilian targets in Ukraine.

author: United24Media
text: Iraq has halted oil production at fields operated by foreign companies after disruptions to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, Reuters reports.  The country declared force majeure at all such fields after military activity in the region effectively blocked most oil exports. Most of Iraq’s exports pass through the Strait of Hormuz, and the disruption has pushed storage capacity “to its limits,” the Oil Ministry said.  “International partners have been unable to provide tankers to transport the oil, which has hampered exports, despite the state-owned oil company SOMO being ready to load shipments,” the ministry said in a letter.  “In light of the situation, the ministry has ordered a complete halt to production in the affected concession areas, and under the terms of the contract, this measure does not provide for any compensation,” the letter added.  Oil Minister Hayan Abdel-Ghani said production at the Basra Oil Company had been cut to 900,000 barrels per day from 3.3 million. The produced oil is being redirected to keep refineries operating.  The scale of the reduction will be reviewed depending on developments in the region, and companies have been invited to urgent negotiations on operations, costs, and staffing under force majeure conditions.  The drop in production and exports is expected to worsen Iraq’s already fragile financial situation, as the country relies on oil revenues for more than 90% of its government income.

author: United24Media
text: 🕯 Russians struck a residential area in Zaporizhzhia. One person was killed and seven others were injured.  One woman is in serious condition, while doctors assess the condition of the others as moderate. Earlier, another woman was found under the rubble, said the head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration, Ivan Fedorov.

author: United24Media
text: Hunting with optical drones continues.  As a result of effective operations, four light vehicles and five motor vehicles were destroyed.

author: United24Media
text: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy spoke about his meeting with French President Emmanuel Macron in Paris.  “Today we talked with Emmanuel primarily about security — the security of Ukraine, Europe, and global security, particularly in light of developments in the Middle East and the Gulf region.  Of course, today and always, we have substantive coordination with Emmanuel on issues of protecting Ukraine and strengthening our defense. We are paying significant attention to joint defense production. We discussed bilateral projects and the SAFE program. We identified steps and specific solutions that can deliver strong results. This applies both to air defense and combat aviation,” the president said.

author: United24Media
text: 🇪🇺🇺🇦 EU leaders want to know the date when the Druzhba oil pipeline can be resumed, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.  “We are discussing this issue with the President of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, as well as with the President of the European Council, António Costa. During our last phone conversations, we agreed that Ukraine should give the EU leaders a date for a possible restoration. This means when there will be an opportunity to resume oil supplies in terms of technical processes and timelines. Our NJSC Naftogaz is in contact, they are working on this,” he said.  The president added that he had previously received information from Naftogaz that oil supplies could be restored in one and a half to two months.  “But we must understand that only the possibility of supplies will be restored. We are not talking about restoring the reservoirs yet. If we also restore what was destroyed by missiles, there is the largest reservoir in Central Europe,” he added.

author: United24Media
text: 🕯 Russians struck Zaporizhzhia. A woman was killed as a result of the attack. Two more women were injured and are under medical supervision, said the head of the regional military administration, Ivan Fedorov.  Previously, a 16-year-old girl was reported to be under the rubble. The search and rescue operation is ongoing.

author: United24Media
text: US policy toward Russia has not changed, despite temporary measures in the energy market. Russian oil remains under sanctions, US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said on CNN.

author: United24Media
text: All regions of Russia are now under threat of Ukrainian drone strikes, said Russian Security Council Secretary Sergei Shoigu at an off-site meeting in Yekaterinburg.  According to him, until recently the Urals were out of reach of strikes from Ukrainian territory, but are now under immediate threat.  Shoigu noted that the Urals are home to strategic defense industry enterprises, as well as energy and chemical facilities, major oil and gas fields, key railway lines, and important highways.  “Disabling them could not only cause significant economic damage but also destabilize the functioning of large metropolitan areas and disrupt supply chains, including those critical to the provision of the ‘SVO.’”

author: United24Media
text: A Russian Ka-52 helicopter was hunted down by pilots of the Baltika crew from the 1st Battalion “Predators of the Heights” of the 59th Separate Assault Brigade near Nadiyivka in the Donetsk region.  After making an emergency landing, the helicopter crew attempted to flee. Drones from the Unmanned Systems Forces then struck the area and completed the engagement, according to Robert “Magyar” Brovdy, commander of the Unmanned Systems Forces.

author: United24Media
text: Russian gold medalists at the 2026 Winter Paralympics dedicated their awards to Vladimir Putin, not to the country or the people. This shows that they represent not only their country, but also terrorism, war, and military aggression. This is terrible, said Valeriy Sushkevych in a comment to Deutsche Presse-Agentur.  “No, we will never take part in this ceremony (the closing of the Paralympic Games in Italy). They are raising the flag of a killer state there. These Paralympic Games are the worst in history,” he said.

author: United24Media
text: Oil prices for immediate delivery have reached $150 per barrel in some markets, the Financial Times reports.  Amid escalation in the Middle East, the market has split: Brent futures rose to $114 per barrel, while physical deliveries “here and now” are trading significantly higher.  For example, Omani crude, which can bypass the Strait of Hormuz, has already traded at nearly $154 per barrel.  Experts explain the gap by noting that futures prices reflect expectations of stabilization, while the physical market is already reacting to supply shortages and disruptions.

author: United24Media
text: Oscar-winning director Chloé Zhao has launched a fundraiser for animal volunteers in Kharkiv.  The Hollywood director, known for films such as Nomadland, Eternals, and Hamnet, initiated a charity auction in support of Animal Rescue Kharkiv.  She put up an unusual lot on the Charitybuzz platform — an online meeting described as a “virtual cup of tea” with the auction winner.  All proceeds will go toward supporting teams that rescue animals in frontline areas.  “In a region devastated by war, animals are too often forgotten victims. We find them where others cannot, treat their wounds — both visible and invisible — and provide shelter until they are ready for a new life. Behind all this is a tremendous effort, with more than 110 people working together in the face of constant challenges to ensure that compassion does not fade even in the hardest times,” Zhao said.

author: United24Media
text: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stressed that the €90 billion loan for Ukraine, already agreed upon in the EU, must be disbursed urgently.  He also emphasized the need to adopt the 20th package of EU sanctions against Russia as soon as possible.

author: United24Media
text: Türkiye is ready to host the next round of talks between Ukraine and Russia. It is essential that the parties return to the negotiating table to end the war as soon as possible, Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said during a phone call with Sergey Lavrov.

author: United24Media
text: Self-proclaimed President of Belarus Alexander Lukashenko has threatened to “get” NATO countries if they consider the Russian Oreshnik missile system deployed in Belarus a “legitimate military target.”  “What do you think, if they consider objects on the territory of Belarus to be legitimate targets, I will just sleep and watch? We can reach 70 km, 200 km. We have the means to strike. Therefore, I would advise them not to chatter and not to bark. They consider Oreshnik a legitimate target — please,” he said.

author: United24Media
text: With changing weather conditions, the Russian aggressor has increased pressure on several fronts. For several consecutive days, the number of combat clashes has exceeded 200. At the same time, enemy losses have also risen significantly: from Tuesday to Thursday alone, about 4,840 Russian troops were killed and wounded, said Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, Oleksandr Syrskyi.  “The activity of overwhelming enemy forces requires us to make new, asymmetric decisions. Ukrainian troops are acting proactively, seizing the initiative and continuing to restore positions,” he said.

author: United24Media
text: ❗️According to updated information, two people were killed and four others were injured in a Russian strike in Brovary, Kyiv region, Mayor Ihor Sapozhko said.  “People continue to go to hospitals, so exact information on the number of injured will be provided later,” he noted.

author: United24Media
text: The French fashion house Louis Vuitton has unveiled a new collection by creative director Nicolas Ghesquière, featuring works by contemporary Ukrainian artist Nazar Strelyaiev-Nazarko.  Born in Kharkiv and now working in Milan, Strelyaiev-Nazarko created paintings that were used as prints for the clothing in the collection. One of his works, Paramnesia, was reinterpreted for the collection.   In the runway version, some elements of the painting were altered—most notably, one of the lambs depicted in the original artwork, which wore rubber boots typical of rural life, is now shown wearing luxury boots adorned with Louis Vuitton’s signature monogram.

author: United24Media
text: Vladimir Putin’s former translator has been appointed as an OSCE observer in the Hungarian elections, Reuters reports.  According to the publication, Hungarian human rights activists have raised concerns about the participation of Daria Boyarska in the observer mission for the parliamentary elections in Hungary on April 12.  The Hungarian Helsinki Committee called on the OSCE to remove her “to ensure trust and confidentiality.”  Boyarska is currently an adviser to the OSCE Parliamentary Assembly. She previously worked in the Russian Foreign Ministry and served as an interpreter at meetings between Putin and Donald Trump. Poland added her to its sanctions list in 2022.  VSquare journalist Szabolcs Panyi noted that Boyarska’s relatives work in structures linked to the Kremlin, which could pose risks of influence.  She declined to answer questions about the war and possible ties to Russian intelligence.

author: United24Media
text: Every approach to the Phoenix border guard position turns into an adventure.  In a race with a ground-based robotic complex called “Autobot,” border guard Lavr and his comrades head to the position through shattered villages and devastated areas of a front-line city in the Donetsk region.

text: The Ukrainian Air Force released footage of combat operations against Russian drones in eastern Ukraine.

author: United24Media
text: Russia aims to produce up to 1,000 drones per day, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in an interview with New York Post.  According to him, Russia is reducing missile production and redirecting funding to expand drone output.  To counter Russian drones with interceptor drones, Ukraine would need 2,000–3,000 interceptors per day.  “What is our expertise? The fact that an interceptor drone costs $3,000–5,000. A ‘Shahed’ costs about $10,000, while a missile for a Patriot system costs $4 million. Ukraine spends $10,000 to shoot down a drone, while a Middle Eastern country spends $4 million. This is the experience we offer.”
